newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 24.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday::
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrial average fell 20.87 points to 6,812.72 as investors turned cautious after propelling the Dow 173 points higher on Tuesday.

* The Indonesian government would ask state-owned banks to help finance the country's national car programme, Bisnis Indonesia newspaper reported Trade and Industry Minister Tungky Ariwibowo as saying.
* On Wednesday, the composite index rose 5.21 points, or 0.81 percent, to close at 651.45 points.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,427.00/8.00 at 0230 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,420.50/21.50.
* Bank Bira after a sharp rise in the firm's first quarter net profit.
* Telkom after reports the firm would pay a dividend of 41.25 rupiah per share for 1996.
* Small-sized property firm Elang Realty on continued market talk of a possible rights issue.
